name: Critically Overdriven
notes: Effects Database documents a dedicated two-level overdrive with v1/v2 records. Geographic attribution remains unresolved and should be researched before canonicalizing region.

name: Ilitch Electronics
dirt_evidence: Classic One Dyna Dist Overdrive; Deep Blues Dyna Dist Overdrive; Heavy Metal Dyna Dist Overdrive
notes: Effects Database gives explicit designed/assembled/tested in USA evidence and multiple distinct gain products. Strong boutique-era census entry.

name: JDM Pedals (Joe Doc Music)
dirt_evidence: Elektrika Germanium Tone Bender Mk1/Zonk Machine style fuzz; Elektrika silicon Buzzaround-style fuzz
notes: Pedals are handmade in Berlin. The Elektrika family has materially different germanium and silicon editions, which belong later in variant/electronics research rather than being flattened.

name: JTK Harmonics
notes: Effects Database documents four products and a manufacturer's manual for Murano. Geographic identity needs confirmation.

name: My Dad Is Iggy
dirt_evidence: Big Muffin; Flashback Driver; Pops To Texas Overdrive; Taxi Overdrive; Texas Blues and other gain products
notes: Run by Ivan Marchetti and Gini. Started in London, later based in Milan. Timeline records first pedal/mods in 1997 and first sale in 2002. Preserve geographic relocation and one-person/partner operation history.

name: NFX Pedals
dirt_evidence: Distort Shi; Distortion+; Fuzz Tool; Octane; Overdrive; Screaming Diodes
notes: Effects Database documents six products, including multiple dirt pedals, and states the pedals were fully hand made. Region requires follow-up.

name: Shin's Music
dirt_evidence: Dumbloid; Dumbloid Special; Bulldog Fuzz and other gain products
notes: Tokyo builder associated with Shin Suzuki. Effects Database currently lists 27 products and explicit handmade D-style overdrives and fuzz. Catalog completion should separate signature editions from core products.

name: Systech
notes: Systems & Technology in Music, Inc. of Kalamazoo. Effects Database documents the Overdrive and Harmonic Energizer lineage and a tiny Overdrive A variant. High-priority historical census entity.

name: Totally Wycked Audio
dirt_evidence: Great Divide; Great Divide MkII; Hot Saké; Krytical Mass bass fuzz; Octoverdrive; Chemical Z dual-channel overdrive; Source Code Tamura Overdrive; SH9 distortion; Wahxidizer octave-fuzz
notes: Effects Database lists 22 products and a historical builder interview. Multiple gain products justify canonical builder treatment.

name: VTR Effects
dirt_evidence: Helios Overdrive; Helios V2/V2.1 and Gold Series
notes: Brazilian company with explicit current manufacturer presence and Helios overdrive lineage. Only one Effects Database model record is currently indexed, so Queue B should verify whether the broader Gold Series contains additional dirt products.

name: Vintage Pedal Workshop
dirt_evidence: Fuzz Sound; Supa Fuzz; Tone Bender MkI; Tone Bender Mk1.5; Tone Bender MkII; Zonk Machine; Exel Shatterbox; F.E.T. Guitar Pre-Amplifier
notes: Founded in 2010 by Steve Giles and Richard Henry. Handmade British reproductions/reinterpretations of historic dirt pedals. Keep modern reproduction products distinct from historical originals and OEM lineages.

name: Garen Electronic Music Instruments MFG.
notes: Paris-based manufacturer better known for amplifiers but documented with a rare domestic French fuzz/distortion introduced around 1966-1970. High-priority historical French census record.
